title: Wither bossbar titles follow name changes
description: With a tracked named charging Wither, change its name and styling while ticks are frozen. A protocol client must verify one UPDATE_TITLE on the existing bossbar UUID per changed component, no update for an identical component, and immediate delivery with NoAI. Initial named ADD must carry the display-name hover/insertion metadata. No rendered-client proof is implied.
notes: Freeze ticks before setup; advance exactly6 ticks after summon to establish tracking and the bar, then keep frozen during all name changes. Read UPDATE_TITLE packets as well as command results; command-only execution cannot validate this regression. The identical-name health merge control reloads NBT without changing the title. Every changed component supplies its style explicitly; unspecified nested-component style merging is a separate shared NBT behavior. Shared CustomName removal and NoAI audience lifecycle are separate.
